author: p_jun
text: Anyone know why paymentservice has no idempotency table anymore?

author: p_anika
text: ADR-012. Ingress handles duplicates now, see G_DEDUPE in ADR-007.

author: p_ravi
text: Redis cluster limits are 48 hours max TTL, ask before raising it.

author: p_omar
text: checkoutservice payment timeout is 1000 ms, do not lower it without talking to Payments.

author: p_jun
text: Heard Paylane may lengthen their retry policy next month.

author: p_sofia
text: emailservice retries are at 5, provider allows 10.

author: p_tess
text: currencyservice cache age is only half the freshness story. The rate publication evidence needs a new review.

author: p_ravi
text: Agreed. A_RATE_TTL can hold while A_RATES_SOURCE remains unverified.

author: p_tess
text: The September 30 review date is in ADR-003. Please do not make the dashboard green by editing dates without evidence.

author: p_ravi
text: I will capture publication and cache insertion timestamps for the runbook.

author: p_tess
text: KES-137 tracks renewal. G_RATES_FRESH stays unknown until the attestation is current.

author: p_sofia
text: That distinction should also appear in on-call handover: unknown means evidence is missing, not a confirmed outage.

author: p_kim
text: adservice cache TTL is 120 seconds. The recorded bound is 300 seconds.

author: p_omar
text: Is a six-minute inventory cache covered by ADR-020?

author: p_kim
text: No. A_AD_CACHE would be false at 360 seconds, and G_ADS_FRESH would be broken.

author: p_omar
text: We should attach the configuration diff rather than rely on a summary of the experiment.

author: p_kim
text: KES-132 has the exact values. This is a lower-tier service, so the review still matters without being a tier-one blocker.

author: p_ravi
text: The platform team can help inspect cache age, but storefront remains the owning team.

author: p_sofia
text: emailservice uses five attempts; emailprovider.max_retries records ten.

author: p_ravi
text: The proposed eight-attempt change remains within the external budget.

author: p_sofia
text: Correct. A_EMAIL_BUDGET holds at eight. We still need separate delivery monitoring.

author: p_tess
text: Does the model check backoff delay or delivery success?

author: p_sofia
text: Neither. ADR-011 promises the attempt budget only. The runbook now says that explicitly.

author: p_ravi
text: Please link KES-134 and the configuration line when this comes up in review.

author: p_omar
text: cartservice session retention is 72 hours today.

author: p_kim
text: A_CART_TTL records a seven-day ceiling, but it is not required by a guarantee.

author: p_omar
text: So exceeding it still needs review, even though there is no guarantee chain to flag.

author: p_kim
text: Yes. The orphan-assumption warning is intentional; we should decide whether a guarantee belongs there.

author: p_tess
text: My storefront membership ended in July. Please route current ownership questions to the active storefront team.

author: p_omar
text: I will keep the retention evidence in KES-138 rather than implying a new guarantee was already adopted.

author: p_ravi
text: productcatalogservice response size grew with the latest attributes.

author: p_tess
text: Do we have an authored guarantee about catalog payload size?

author: p_ravi
text: No. KES-136 is observational evidence, not a machine-checkable guarantee.

author: p_sofia
text: That should be clear in Company Brain answers: absent from the graph does not prove a change is safe.

author: p_ravi
text: I will include request and response sizes, then ask storefront which clients depend on those attributes.

author: p_ravi
text: shippingservice latency and checkoutservice latency are separate measurements in KES-135.

author: p_omar
text: Checkout calls shippingservice for quotes, but this model does not promise an end-to-end shipping deadline.

author: p_sofia
text: Please capture a trace before adding a timeout assumption. We should not invent a bound from one incident.

author: p_ravi
text: Agreed. Ownership and dependency evidence can answer who to ask; a new guarantee needs an authored decision.

author: p_tess
text: Source citations should point to the ticket observation so nobody mistakes it for current policy.
